WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond_rate, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
), average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond_rate) AS simple_average_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT mtr.Name, mtr.bytes_per_millisecond_rate AS rate, mtr.track_count,
       mtr.bytes_per_millisecond_rate - ar.simple_average_rate AS above_average
FROM media_type_rates AS mtr
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS ar
WHERE mtr.bytes_per_millisecond_rate > ar.simple_average_rate;
